Lokayukta Investigates Illegal Sand Mining in Bagalkot, Officials Booked

India's Lokayukta has initiated a suo motu investigation into illegal sand extraction in Bagalkot, Karnataka. The inquiry has reportedly uncovered widespread violations. As a result, officials have been booked in connection with the illegal mining activities.
